/interface ethernet switch
set switch1 l3-hw-offloading=no
/interface ethernet switch l3hw-settings
set autorestart=no ipv6-hw=no
/interface bridge
add name=bridge protocol-mode=none vlan-filtering=yes
/interface ethernet
set [ find default-name=qsfp28-1-1 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=qsfp28-2-1 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-1 ] comment="Hurricane Electric"
set [ find default-name=sfp28-2 ] comment=SGIX
set [ find default-name=sfp28-3 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-4 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-5 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-6 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-7 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-8 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-9 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-10 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-11 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=sfp28-12 ] disabled=yes
set [ find default-name=ether1 ] comment=Management
/interface vlan
add interface=bridge name=transit vlan-id=300
add interface=bridge name=ix vlan-id=200
/interface bridge port
add bridge=bridge frame-types=admit-only-untagged-and-priority-tagged interface=sfp28-1 pvid=300
add bridge=bridge frame-types=admit-only-untagged-and-priority-tagged interface=sfp28-2 pvid=200
/interface bridge vlan
add bridge=bridge comment="IP transit from Hurricane Electric, AS6939" tagged=bridge vlan-ids=300
add bridge=bridge comment="Peering LAN of SGIX" tagged=bridge vlan-ids=200
/ip address
add address=10.0.0.1/24 comment=Management interface=ether1
add address=203.0.113.2/30 interface=transit
add address=192.0.2.10/24 interface=ix
/ipv6 address
add address=2001:db8:ffff::10/64 advertise=no interface=ix
/ip dns
set allow-remote-requests=no servers=""
/ip firewall address-list
add address=203.0.113.1 list=bgp-neighbors
add address=192.0.2.1 list=bgp-neighbors
add address=198.51.100.0/24 list=bgp-networks-v4
/ipv6 firewall address-list
add address=2001:db8:ffff::1 list=bgp-neighbors
add address=2001:db8:100::/48 list=bgp-networks-v6
/ip firewall filter
add action=accept chain=input comment=Replies connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=input comment=Ping protocol=icmp
add action=accept chain=input comment=Management src-address=10.0.0.0/24
add action=accept chain=input comment=BGP dst-port=179 protocol=tcp src-address-list=bgp-neighbors
add action=drop chain=input comment=Default
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags FIN+SYN" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="fin,syn"
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags SYN+RST" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="syn,rst"
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags FIN+RST" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="fin,rst"
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags FIN without ACK" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="fin,!ack"
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags FIN+URG" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="fin,urg"
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags Xmas scan" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="fin,syn,psh,urg"
/ipv6 firewall filter
add action=accept chain=input comment=Replies connection-state="established,related"
add action=accept chain=input comment=Ping protocol=icmpv6
add action=accept chain=input comment=BGP dst-port=179 protocol=tcp src-address-list=bgp-neighbors
add action=drop chain=input comment=Default
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags FIN+SYN" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="fin,syn"
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags SYN+RST" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="syn,rst"
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags FIN+RST" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="fin,rst"
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags FIN without ACK" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="fin,!ack"
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags FIN+URG" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="fin,urg"
add action=drop chain=forward comment="Bad flags Xmas scan" protocol=tcp tcp-flags="fin,syn,psh,urg"
/ip firewall service-port
set ftp disabled=yes
set tftp disabled=yes
set irc disabled=yes
set h323 disabled=yes
set sip disabled=yes
set pptp disabled=yes
set rtsp disabled=yes
/interface ethernet switch rule
add comment="transit: drop source 198.51.100.0/24" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=198.51.100.0/255.255.255.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=300
add comment="transit: drop source 127.0.0.0/8" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=127.0.0.0/255.0.0.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=300
add comment="transit: drop source 169.254.0.0/16" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=169.254.0.0/255.255.0.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=300
add comment="transit: drop source 0.0.0.0/8" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=0.0.0.0/255.0.0.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=300
add comment="transit: drop source 10.0.0.0/8" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=10.0.0.0/255.0.0.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=300
add comment="transit: drop source 172.16.0.0/12" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=172.16.0.0/255.240.0.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=300
add comment="transit: drop source 192.168.0.0/16" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=192.168.0.0/255.255.0.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=300
add comment="ix: drop source 198.51.100.0/24" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=198.51.100.0/255.255.255.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=200
add comment="ix: drop source 127.0.0.0/8" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=127.0.0.0/255.0.0.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=200
add comment="ix: drop source 169.254.0.0/16" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=169.254.0.0/255.255.0.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=200
add comment="ix: drop source 0.0.0.0/8" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-1 src-address=0.0.0.0/255.0.0.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=200

add comment="ix: drop source 192.168.0.0/16" mac-protocol=ip new-dst-ports="" ports=sfp28-2 src-address=192.168.0.0/255.255.0.0 switch=switch1 vlan-id=200
/ip route
add blackhole comment=Originate dst-address=198.51.100.0/24
/ipv6 route
add blackhole comment=Originate dst-address=2001:db8:100::/48
/routing bgp instance
add as=64500 name=default router-id=203.0.113.2
/routing filter rule
add chain=IX-IN-V4 rule="jump SANITY-V4"
add chain=IX-IN-V4 comment="Learned from AS55518" rule="delete bgp-communities regexp \"^64500:[0-9]+\$\"; delete bgp-large-communities regexp \"^64500:[0-9]+:[0-9]+\$\"; append bgp-large-communities 64500:1:2,64500:3:55518"
add chain=IX-IN-V4 rule="set bgp-local-pref 200"
add chain=IX-IN-V4 rule=accept
add chain=IX-IN-V6 rule="jump SANITY-V6"
add chain=IX-IN-V6 comment="Learned from AS55518" rule="delete bgp-communities regexp \"^64500:[0-9]+\$\"; delete bgp-large-communities regexp \"^64500:[0-9]+:[0-9]+\$\"; append bgp-large-communities 64500:1:2,64500:3:55518"
add chain=IX-IN-V6 rule="set bgp-local-pref 200"
add chain=IX-IN-V6 rule=accept
add chain=OUT-V4 comment="Announce 198.51.100.0/24" rule="if (dst==198.51.100.0/24) { accept }"
add chain=OUT-V4 comment="Nothing else leaves" rule=reject
add chain=OUT-V6 comment="Announce 2001:db8:100::/48" rule="if (dst==2001:db8:100::/48) { accept }"
add chain=OUT-V6 comment="Nothing else leaves" rule=reject
add chain=SANITY-V4 comment="IPv4 shorter than /8" rule="if (dst-len<8) { reject }"
add chain=SANITY-V4 comment="IPv4 longer than /24" rule="if (dst-len>24) { reject }"
add chain=SANITY-V4 comment="RPKI invalid" rule="rpki-verify rpki; if (rpki invalid) { reject }"
add chain=SANITY-V6 comment="IPv6 shorter than /16" rule="if (dst-len<16) { reject }"
add chain=SANITY-V6 comment="IPv6 longer than /48" rule="if (dst-len>48) { reject }"
add chain=SANITY-V6 comment="RPKI invalid" rule="rpki-verify rpki; if (rpki invalid) { reject }"
add chain=TRANSIT-IN-V4 rule="jump SANITY-V4"
add chain=TRANSIT-IN-V4 comment="Learned from AS6939" rule="delete bgp-communities regexp \"^64500:[0-9]+\$\"; delete bgp-large-communities regexp \"^64500:[0-9]+:[0-9]+\$\"; append bgp-large-communities 64500:1:1,64500:3:6939"
add chain=TRANSIT-IN-V4 rule="set bgp-local-pref 100"
add chain=TRANSIT-IN-V4 rule=accept
/routing bgp connection
add as=64500 input.filter=TRANSIT-IN-V4 instance=default input.limit-process-routes-ipv4=1200000 local.role=ebgp-customer name=hurricane-electric output.filter-chain=OUT-V4 output.network=bgp-networks-v4 remote.address=203.0.113.1/32 remote.as=6939
add as=64500 input.filter=IX-IN-V4 instance=default input.limit-process-routes-ipv4=100000 local.role=ebgp-rs-client name=sgix-rs-v4 output.filter-chain=OUT-V4 output.network=bgp-networks-v4 remote.address=192.0.2.1/32 remote.as=55518
add as=64500 input.filter=IX-IN-V6 instance=default input.limit-process-routes-ipv6=50000 local.role=ebgp-rs-client name=sgix-rs-v6 output.filter-chain=OUT-V6 output.network=bgp-networks-v6 remote.address=2001:db8:ffff::1/128 remote.as=55518
/ip service
set ftp disabled=yes
set ssh address=10.0.0.0/24 disabled=no
set telnet disabled=yes
set www disabled=yes
set www-ssl disabled=yes
set api disabled=yes
set api-ssl disabled=yes

set reverse-proxy disabled=yes
/ip ssh
set strong-crypto=yes
/tool mac-server
set allowed-interface-list=none

set enabled=no
/tool bandwidth-server
set enabled=no
/ip neighbor discovery-settings
set discover-interface-list=none protocol=lldp
/snmp
set enabled=no
/snmp community
set [ find default=yes ] addresses=::/0 name=public
/user
add group=full name=operator password="<secret:EDGE_01_PASSWORD>"
/ip settings
set send-redirects=no tcp-syncookies=no
/system identity
set name=edge-01
/system clock

set enabled=yes
